title: Pinned base + per-item evidence check raises cheap-model classification accuracy to >= 0.9
summary: If classification runs against the base commit and every implemented/partial claim must cite a symbol that a deterministic grep confirms, cheap-model accuracy on the EVC development set rises from 0.75 to >= 0.9 at <= 1.5x cost. RESULT (EXP-0001): rejected; the verifier changed 1 of 27 answers and no route approached 0.9.
